name: Juno Hartley
why: Shares about 38% of Maya's listeners. Her last single brought a similar wave from algorithmic playlists.
first_step: Suggest a joint acoustic session or a split-bill show.

name: The Paper Lanterns
why: A guitar-led band at a similar size, playing the same small venues.
first_step: Offer a support slot swap for each other's next headline.

name: Cobalt Room
why: A 300-capacity room that books indie pop on Thursdays and fits her draw.
first_step: Send the booker one link, a short pitch and her Melbourne listener count.

name: Tess Marlow
why: Runs a local-artists playlist that many of Maya's listeners already follow.
first_step: Send the next single a week before release with a one-line pitch.

name: Ravi Anand
why: Produced two recent local releases with strong save rates.
first_step: Ask for a coffee and a listen to a demo, not a booking.

name: Late Bloom Radio
why: Weekly local show that plays new independent music and interviews artists.
first_step: Submit Afterglow with a short story about the song.
